# ATUONA — Underground Aesthetic Gallery & AI Film Studio

> ATUONA is an underground-aesthetic online gallery and AI film studio by poet Elena Revicheva: 99 poems in the vault and seven finished short films made with AI, from script to score.

Created by **Elena Revicheva** — poet, AI film-maker and founder of the AIdeazz AI Lab (Panama City).
Portfolio: https://aideazz.xyz/portfolio

## Canonical pages (cite these URLs)

- [ATUONA gallery — the poetry vault (99 poems)](https://atuona.xyz/)
- [AI Film Studio — seven finished films, watch free](https://atuona.xyz/aifilmstudio/)

## How the films are made

An automated pipeline turns a written idea into a finished film: script by an LLM, generated images, AI motion
from several video models with per-shot fallback, then an automated edit — narration, crossfades, a mixed score —
and publication. Each film is checked frame by frame before release. The source material is Elena's own poetry.
